import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, time, urllib.request

repo = pathlib.Path(r"E:\WebAIBridge")
expected_head = "e8033f2e42bd335c10a397eb3d2cb62c8bb837a9"
pre_head = "cb852e013634287669f957253d13d8ef2b45cada"
manifest_path = pathlib.Path(r"E:\WebAIBridge\app\data\backups\r42-cutover-20261006T043453Z\rollback-manifest.json")
cutover_state_path = repo / "app" / "data" / "projects-live-control-plane-cutover-r42.json"
allowed = [
    "app/scripts/operator-lifecycle-r40.ps1",
    "app/scripts/pause-all-r40.cmd",
    "app/scripts/pause-browser-r40.cmd",
    "app/scripts/resume-attach-r40.cmd",
    "app/scripts/resume-managed-r40.cmd",
]

def run(args, check=True, timeout=30):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(repo), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=timeout)
    if check and p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"command failed {p.returncode}: {args}\nSTDOUT={p.stdout.decode(errors='replace')}\nSTDERR={p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')}")
    return p

head = run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.decode().strip()
if head != expected_head:
    raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected current head: {head}")

status = run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"status","--porcelain"]).stdout.decode().splitlines()
paths = [x[3:].strip() for x in status if x.strip()]
if set(paths) != set(allowed):
    raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected dirty set: {paths}")

for rel in allowed:
    actual = (repo / rel).read_bytes()
    expected = run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"show","HEAD:"+rel]).stdout
    if actual != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f"apparent dirty path is not raw-byte identical to HEAD: {rel}")

if not cutover_state_path.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("cutover state missing")
state = json.loads(cutover_state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
if state.get("status") != "CUTOVER_HOLD_PREPARED" or state.get("holdActive") is not True:
    raise RuntimeError(f"unexpected cutover state: {state.get('status')} hold={state.get('holdActive')}")
if pathlib.Path(state.get("rollbackManifest","")) != manifest_path:
    raise RuntimeError("rollback manifest pointer drift")

manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
if manifest.get("object") != "bridge.projects_live_control_plane_rollback.r42.v1":
    raise RuntimeError("invalid rollback manifest object")
if manifest.get("preCutoverHead") != pre_head or manifest.get("targetSha") != expected_head:
    raise RuntimeError("rollback manifest authority mismatch")
if pathlib.Path(manifest.get("repoPath","")).resolve() != repo.resolve():
    raise RuntimeError("rollback repo path mismatch")
data_root = pathlib.Path(manifest["dataPath"]).resolve()

# Force switch is authorized only after the exact byte-equality checks above.
run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"switch","--force","--detach",pre_head], timeout=20)
restored_head = run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.decode().strip()
if restored_head != pre_head:
    raise RuntimeError(f"failed to restore pre-cutover head: {restored_head}")

restored_entries=[]
for entry in manifest.get("backups",[]):
    source = pathlib.Path(entry["source"]).resolve()
    if os.path.commonpath([str(source), str(data_root)]) != str(data_root):
        raise RuntimeError(f"rollback source escapes data root: {source}")
    if entry.get("existed") is True:
        backup = pathlib.Path(entry["backup"]).resolve()
        if not backup.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"missing backup: {backup}")
        source.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(backup, source)
        restored_entries.append({"name":entry["name"],"action":"restored"})
    else:
        if source.exists():
            source.unlink()
            restored_entries.append({"name":entry["name"],"action":"removed_new"})
        else:
            restored_entries.append({"name":entry["name"],"action":"already_absent"})

# Start the exact pre-cutover Bridge.
start = repo / "app" / "start.ps1"
p = subprocess.run(
    ["powershell.exe","-NoProfile","-ExecutionPolicy","Bypass","-File",str(start)],
    cwd=str(repo/"app"), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=35
)
if p.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError("pre-cutover start.ps1 failed: "+p.stderr.decode(errors="replace"))

deadline=time.time()+30
status_api=None
last_error=None
while time.time()<deadline:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/status", timeout=2) as resp:
            status_api=json.load(resp)
        break
    except Exception as exc:
        last_error=str(exc)
        time.sleep(0.5)
if status_api is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Bridge did not recover after manual rollback: "+str(last_error))

final_head = run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.decode().strip()
final_status = run(["git.exe","-C",str(repo),"status","--porcelain"]).stdout.decode().strip()

print(json.dumps({
    "object":"bridge.r42.manual_rollback_recovery.v1",
    "status":"ROLLED_BACK",
    "restoredHead":final_head,
    "worktreeStatus":final_status,
    "bridgeResponsive":True,
    "serverStartedAt":status_api.get("serverStartedAt"),
    "restoredEntries":restored_entries,
    "manifest":str(manifest_path),
    "providerChatDeletionPerformed":False
}, ensure_ascii=False))

note: Manual guarded rollback of R42 apply-03. Force switch allowed only after exact dirty-set and raw-byte equality proof; restore only manifest-backed data.
